name: FreshBooks
summary: General small-business accounting with estimates and invoices.
differentiator: A general accounting tool that ranks itself first in its own "electrical estimating software" guide. That guide never mentions NEC, and the product has no electrical database.
pricing: List prices: Lite $23 a month (5 billable clients), Plus $43 (50), Premium $70 (unlimited). Select is by quote. Team members are $11 a month each. Introductory discounts appear on the page and change.

scope.takeoff: None described on the pages we read.
scope.library: Estimates and invoices from templates. No electrical database is described.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Line items you enter. No price feed is named.

bestFor: Electricians who mainly need invoicing and bookkeeping and write simple estimates.
skipIf: You want electrical-specific takeoff or assemblies.
watchOut: Client limits apply on the lower plans.
Its guide ranks FreshBooks "Best overall" and is vendor content.
